Grace Huang: Hey team — I handed in my resignation yesterday. My official last day will be 2026-05-12. Wanted to confirm benefits cutoff, COBRA timing, and laptop return logistics.

Jill (People Ops): Thanks for the heads up, Grace. We received the notice. Short version: active benefits end on your last day of employment. COBRA election window is 60 days from the loss-of-coverage date; packets are sent within ~7 business days after separation. Final paycheck + PTO payout processed with the next payroll cycle after your last day.

Grace Huang: Good to know. Any paperwork I need to complete now?

Jill (People Ops): Please fill the offboarding form here: https://people.redwood.com/offboard (link). We'll also email the COBRA packet (elect online at benefits.redwood.com/cobra or via paper form). If you want help with the enrollment process we can walk through it.

offboard-bot: Offboarding record created: OFFBOARD-2012345678. Tasks auto-assigned to IT, Manager, People Ops.

Marco (IT): Hi Grace — for access we'll deprovision SSO at 6:00pm PT on your last day unless you request different timing. Laptop return options: (1) prepaid FedEx label, (2) in-office dropoff. Which do you prefer? Also export MFA recovery codes and back up any personal files.

Grace Huang: Prepaid label please — I'll be remote that week. Also can you delay SSO cut at end-of-day Friday until 6pm PT? I have a couple of handover meetings.

Marco (IT): Prepaid label = yes. We'll send label and return instructions to your personal email on 2026-05-11. SSO will be changed at 6pm PT on 2026-05-12 (we'll keep it until end-of-day as requested).

Ben (Manager): Grace — we'll schedule 3 KT sessions: product overview, current roadmap, and outstanding bugs. Can you prepare a 1-page doc + 20–30 min recorded walkthrough? Tag me + Samir when ready.

Grace Huang: Will do. I'll post the doc and screen recording by 2026-05-09.

Samir Patel: Also please list repo owners and any PagerDuty rotations to be reassigned. I'll take repo transfers once you post the list.

Jill (People Ops): A few benefits/comp notes for the record: Health/dental/vision terminate end of last day. 401(k) admin contact will be sent so you can roll over. Equity/vesting questions go to comp@redwood.com — they handle post-termination vesting windows and any repurchase details.

Grace Huang: Quick COBRA question: if I elect within the 60-day window, does coverage start the day after my last day or retroactively?

Jill (People Ops): COBRA coverage is retroactive to the loss-of-coverage date if you elect and pay premiums; the admin will provide specifics. Practical start requires completed enrollment + payment but it can be applied retroactively to avoid a coverage gap. We'll include the COBRA admin contact in the packet.

Marco (IT): Reminder: export SSH keys and remove personal keys from company repos. If you want a delegated inbox/calendar access for Ben for 2 weeks, we can add that now.

Grace Huang: Please add delegated access for calendar and let Ben access my inbox for two weeks. Also: FedEx label — send to grace.h.personal@gmail.com.

Ben (Manager): Calendar delegate added. I'll coordinate the KT sessions and update the team doc.

offboard-bot: OFFBOARD-2012345678 summary:
- IT: send prepaid label (assigned Marco)
- People Ops: send COBRA packet & exit interview invite (assigned Jill)
- Manager: schedule KT sessions + repo reassignment (assigned Ben)
Status: open

Marco (IT): Prepaid label sent to grace.h.personal@gmail.com — tracking #FX123456789. Return instructions included.

Grace Huang: Received the label, thanks Marco. One last ask — can People Ops share the exit interview questions ahead of time? I'd like to prepare.

Jill (People Ops): Sure — I'll DM you the exit interview form and a quick list of typical prompts. We can do an in-person chat on 2026-05-12 at 10:00am PT (I'll send calendar invite) or you can submit written responses.

Grace Huang: 10:00am PT on 5/12 works for me. Thanks everyone — appreciate the smooth process :heart:

offboard-bot: OFFBOARD-2012345678: last update logged 2026-05-11 15:42:00 PT.
